messages:
Rae (Content): Early draft ready for the product launch blog. Putting benchmark highlights + webinar CTA in the hero. Need quick checks: Legal on numeric claims, Demand Gen on gating + HS form fields, Growth on headline variants, Ops on publish timing. Can everyone glance by EOD Mon? :memo:
Drew (Product): Paste the benchmark line here so I can confirm the baseline and infra details. Also want to confirm model names used in the test.
Rae (Content): Draft snippet: 
"Across our tests, Redwood Inference cut per-token serving cost by as much as 45% versus a stock PyTorch FP16 runtime on long-context (8k) workloads, while producing comparable automated-eval scores; full methodology below."

Hero CTA: "See the demo + register for the launch webinar".
Ana (Legal): Heads-up: prefer "as much as" and include a clear link to the methodology/runbook. Also avoid implying identical quality; suggest: "while maintaining comparable results in our automated evaluations (see methodology)". Please add hardware, batch, and quantization details to the appendix.
Priya (Demand Gen): For the webinar gating: I recommend gating the benchmark slides but making the recording public after. That gives us a strong lead magnet. For HS form we need hidden fields for utm and product_interest. Proposed snippet:

```
formId: "hs_launch_q3_2026"
hiddenFields: ["utm_source","utm_campaign","product_interest","company_tier"]
redirect: "/thanks/launch-slides"
```

Also: what's the webinar date? need at least 10 days to run promos.
Cal (Growth): Headline A/B suggestion: (A) "Cut inference cost without trading latency" vs (B) "Predictable LLM inference for production". Recommend we test for CTR on hero CTA, target a 7% CTR -> 20% reg. Also add a UTM to CTA: 

/blog/redwood-inference-launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_term=hero

so we can isolate traffic.
Ivy (Ops): Proposed publish: Mon 2026-09-13 10:00 PT with partner embargo at 09:30 PT. I can slot the CMS entry and run the preflight on Fri. Need final permalink and OG image. Also will validate the HS form staging.
Rae (Content): Timeline: lock copy Mon EOD; legal signoff Tue morning; demand-gen builds form Tue afternoon; ops preflight Fri; publish Mon 10:00 PT. Permalink suggestion: /blog/introducing-redwood-inference. Open to edits.
Ana (Legal): Additions: please include the run command and seed in the methodology link, example: 

pytorch_benchmark.sh --fp16 --no_xformers --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --seed 42

If the appendix links to a private runbook, mark it "methodology (internal)" and ensure public-facing claims are hedged.
Drew (Product): Confirmed hardware: A10G cluster, quantization tested: int8 + GPTQ on select variants. I'll attach a short table of variants to the runbook.
Priya (Demand Gen): Modal copy draft for registration: "Get the benchmark slides + ops checklist". Also want to capture model_interest values (e.g., "hosted","dedicated","private"). Will add those as a select in the form.
Cal (Growth): Also recommend a short social teaser for the webinar that references the cost reduction but without a granular number: "New benchmarks show meaningful cost reductions for long-context inference" and send numeric details to the blog. That makes social safer for claims.
Ivy (Ops): Ops checklist (short):
- CMS draft in draft state
- canonical + OG image ready
- HS form in staging + test submission
- CTA UTMs applied
- embargo scheduled in CMS
- CDN/Edge cache invalidation plan

I'll run a staging publish test Fri 15:00 PT.
Rae (Content): Linking the internal runbook here: <internal.link>/benchmarks/redwood-inference-2026-runbook (attached). I updated the appendix to include hardware, commands, seeds, and the evaluation dataset names. Edited the benchmark sentence per Ana's suggestion.
Ana (Legal): Reviewing appendix. One small language tweak: change "comparable automated-eval scores" to "comparable automated-evaluation metrics" for clarity. Other than that, I can sign off once the appendix link is live on the draft page.
Drew (Product): Added the variant table to the runbook and noted which model checkpoints were used. Also included quantization notes and perf scripts.
Priya (Demand Gen): Final HS config I dropped into the draft:

```
formId: "hs_launch_q3_2026"
hiddenFields: {
  "utm_source": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "ri_launch_q3",
  "product_interest": "inference_platform"
}
redirect: "/thanks/launch-slides"
```

Ops, can you verify redirect in staging?
Ivy (Ops): Will test staging form Fri 15:00 PT and post the result.
Rae (Content): Quick approval checklist: Ana -> wording + appendix link ok? Priya -> form + modal ready? Cal -> headline A/B chosen? Ivy -> staging test scheduled?
Ana (Legal): Wording change accepted, pending appendix link lives on the live draft page.
Priya (Demand Gen): Form ready from my side, will QA after Ops test.
Cal (Growth): A/B headlines confirmed. I'll upload test variants to the CMS.
Ivy (Ops): Staging publish and HS form test scheduled for Fri 15:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Publish job queued: 2026-09-13T10:00:00-07:00 (blog/introducing-redwood-inference).
Rae (Content): Thanks team. Please react when your item is done so I can close the thread. :rocket:
